aero_cam_sync.configuration.title: Aeronautics Camera Sync Config
aero_cam_sync.configuration.enabled.tool: Enables or disables the entire mod
aero_cam_sync.configuration.ignoreServer: Works regardless of server-side mod presence
aero_cam_sync.configuration.allow3rdPers: Apply camera tilt in third-person view
aero_cam_sync.configuration.rotateCamera: Tilt the camera based on surface normal
aero_cam_sync.configuration.moveCamera.t: Shift camera position along with tilt
aero_cam_sync.configuration.dropFromCame: Tossed items fly out from the tilted camera (origin and direction) instead of the hitbox head
aero_cam_sync.configuration.cameraCollis: Keep the shifted camera out of solid blocks — prevents seeing through walls (X-ray) when tilted next to a wall
How smoothly the tilt eases off as the camera nears a wall, in ticks (0 = instant, higher = smoother)
Interpolation speed per frame. 0.0 = instant, 9999 = never
aero_cam_sync.configuration.minNormalY.t: Maximum camera tilt angle (0.0 = any, 1.0 = flat only)
aero_cam_sync.configuration.dropCacheOnA: prevents the camera from tilting again when the player moves above the level
aero_cam_sync.configuration.disableOnFly: Disable tilt when player start flying (creative, spectator)
aero_cam_sync.configuration.gateMass.too: Tilt only when the sub-level mass is ≥ the value (primary factor)
aero_cam_sync.configuration.gateBlocks.t: Tilt only when the sub-level block count is ≥ the value
aero_cam_sync.configuration.gateLength.t: Tilt only when the sub-level length (X, blocks) is ≥ the value
aero_cam_sync.configuration.gateHeight.t: Tilt only when the sub-level height (Y, blocks) is ≥ the value
aero_cam_sync.configuration.gateWidth.to: Tilt only when the sub-level width (Z, blocks) is ≥ the value
aero_cam_sync.configuration.clientBlackl: Disable camera tilt for blacklisted items
Disable camera tilt when holding a listed item (mod installed only on client)
aero_cam_sync.configuration.autoDisableF: Automatically disable tilt for projectile- and bucket-like items (detected by class, covers modded items) so they throw/place toward the crosshair
aero_cam_sync.configuration.serverBlackl: Disable camera tilt when holding a listed item (mod installed on server)
aero_cam_sync.configuration.count.toolti: Number of rays used to sample the surface
aero_cam_sync.configuration.downLength.t: Max distance downward from player to detect a surface
aero_cam_sync.configuration.upLength.too: Vertical offset from feet where raycasts start
aero_cam_sync.configuration.rays.tooltip: Render all raycast lines in the world
aero_cam_sync.configuration.pickRaysTime: How long will the pick rays remain visible
aero_cam_sync.configuration.keybind.conf: Key is already in use, may cause conflicts!
aero_cam_sync.configuration.btn.reset.to: Reset current category. Hold Shift to unlock this button
aero_cam_sync.configuration.hardLimitWar: One or more parameters are invalid
screen.aero_cam_sync.config_reset.title: Aeronautics Camera Sync — Config Reset
screen.aero_cam_sync.config_reset.body1: Your config file is outdated and may cause issues.
